blocks.html: For nearly twenty-five years Barbara Meyer was one of Luis Barragán's closest friends. The house was his gift to her: the last he designed, and the only one dedicated in his own hand.

image.alt: Black and white print of Barbara Meyer in a headscarf beside Luis Barragán in a hat and glasses
image.caption: Barbara Meyer and Luis Barragán.

blocks.html: [How Barbara and Luis met, the years they knew each other, what she remembered of him and he of her, and how the house came about. To be written with the family.]

image.caption: Watercolor after the photograph.

blocks.html: On the south elevation he wrote para Baby Meyer de Garate, con todo cariño; on the west elevation, con mi cariño. Both are dated 31 October 1978. He was seventy-six and his office had all but closed.
